capabilities: Manage tasks in a folder of Markdown files with one file per list and one line per task
Organize tasks into heading-based groups with drag-and-drop reordering across lists
Track due dates, scheduled dates, reminders, repeats, and My Day using the Obsidian Tasks emoji format
Open cross-list views such as My Day, Important, Planned and Tasks, plus a post-it card wall
Promote a task line into its own linked note
extras: The post-it wall view is experimental and off by default. The author states the plugin is co-created with AI ('vibe coded'). Deeper design rationale is in an external DESIGN.md file.
motivation: Born out of the author's frustration with reminder and todo-list apps that are not syncable, easy to use or ergonomic.
problem: Obsidian task handling relies on raw Markdown editing, and external reminder/todo apps are often not syncable or ergonomic within the vault.
